description: This file defines API route handlers for orders in a food delivery backend, using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for placing orders, retrieving user orders, and getting order details by ID. It also contains internal functions for calculating total prices and simulating background processing of orders.

methods.name: calculate_total_price(item_ids)
methods.description: Calculates total price for given list of menu item IDs by summing their prices from the in-memory menu_items database.

methods.name: fake_background_order_processing(order_id: int)
methods.description: Simulates asynchronous order processing by updating order status over time in a background task.

methods.name: place_order( o: OrderCreate, BackgroundTasks: BackgroundTasks, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends() )
methods.description: API endpoint to place a new order; creates order record, initiates background processing, and returns the created order.

methods.name: get_my_orders(Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve all orders for the authenticated user.

methods.name: get_order(order_id: int, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a specific order by ID.

ctags.name: place_order
ctags.signature: ( o: OrderCreate, BackgroundTasks: BackgroundTasks, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends() )
